title: Pass HireVues by answering the marking scheme
subtitle: Why one-way video interviews get rejected, how they are really marked, and what to change. Written from zero.

points.head: It is marked on content
points.text: HireVue’s AI reads only a transcript of your words. Human markers count evidence against a rating scale.

points.head: It is a ranking, not a pass mark
points.text: Under 1% of applicants at the largest banks get an offer, and some rejections are decided before the video.

points.head: You can test which problem is yours
points.text: A one-week diagnosis separates content, script, camera and causes outside the video.

meta: Prepared 26 November 2026 · Based on five research strands and 225 cited sources · Evidence limits stated throughout
how: How to read this. Sections 1 to 6 explain how the stage works and why people are cut. Sections 7 to 10 are what to do about it. Square brackets in example answers, like [result you measured], mark facts only you can supply.
Sources. Bracketed names in the text are links to the source for the sentence before them. Where the evidence is weak or sources disagree, the text says so.
